title: Elevator Action²: Returns
native_title: エレベーター・アクション ～リターンズ～
overview:
Can you withstand this impact?

Race through the skyscrapers and thwart the plot of the vicious terrorists. The fierce battle of three elite agents has begun.

Elevator Action Returns brings the arcade sequel to Elevator Action home. A three-member counter-terrorism squad must break into terrorist-held buildings, grab the secret data behind the red doors and get out fast. Choose explosives expert Jad the Tough, sharpshooter Edie Burret or close-combat specialist Kart Bradfield, each with their own handgun, special explosive and weapon upgrades. Ride elevators up and down, crush foes beneath them, shoot out the lights, blow up oil drums and pick up items behind blue doors as you fight through six stages across a variety of locations. Finish the game and the original Elevator Action becomes playable too.

- 1 or 2 players cooperatively, with a second player able to join at any time
- Three playable agents with different strengths
- Four difficulty levels
- Memory backup save for high scores and progress

君はこの衝撃に耐えられるか

高層ビルを駆け抜け、凶悪テロリストの陰謀を阻止せよ。3人の精鋭達の熱き戦いが始まった。
